candidate.answerReason: An arithmetic sequence satisfies \(a_{n+1}=a_n+d\). Thus C describes adding the signed common difference, including when it is zero or negative.

methods.label: Definition of common difference
methods.explanation: Adjacent terms differ by \(d\). Each time the index increases by 1, the common difference is added to the term.
methods.levelReason: The definition of an arithmetic sequence directly answers the question without requiring function techniques.
